r.locality: Yeronga Park. Southern boundary near School Road.
r.notes: Situated in the fork of a large Tallowwood (Eucalyptus microcorys)approximately 15m above ground height. It was being mobbed by a resident Magpie and surrounded by noisy Rainbow lorikeets who are also nesting in the park.It may be a male dispersing from a resident population in Toohey Forest (recent ALA records from July). The shortest likely route would be via Taragindi Hill reserve and then through a network of urban streets approximately 900m to the park including crossing Ipswich Road.My first sighting of a koala in this park in the 12 years I've lived nearby. Only one record on ALA for Yeronga from 1989.
